gbm_population_evidence.quote: Glioblastoma; Glioblastoma Multiforme; Glioblastoma Multiforme of Brain; Glioblastoma Multiforme, Adult

candidate_evidence.quote: [EXPERIMENTAL] Posaconazole: Participants will be taking 300 mg of the study drug (three 100 mg tablets) by mouth twice a day the first day

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Evidence of primary or recurrent HGG that in the opinion of the treating team would require surgical resection

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: Posaconazole Concentration in Cerebrospinal Fluid Using Microdialysis Catheters: Assessment of the concentration of drug in the dialysate fluid.
This method allows for continuous measurement of ECF within a tumor or normal tissue.

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: Posaconazole Effect on Hexokinase 2 Concentration Within Tumor Tissue: Measured using a hexokinase-2 ELISA with a range of 1.56 ng/mL - 100 ng/mL on tumor tissue.

role_evidence.quote: [DRUG] Posaconazole Pill (other names: Noxafil): 300 mg (three 100 mg tablets) orally

agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: inhibition of HK2 activity (glycolysis) reducing tumor cell proliferation

coder_notes: Early Phase 1 (phase 0) trial. Eligibility says primary or recurrent HGG, but conditions name glioblastoma. Control arm (no intervention) is a registered NO_INTERVENTION arm, so control_arm_from_other_arms is no.
